source: Screenshots of the comments taken by the creator a few hours after posting. The automated snapshot was not run for this round because the Instagram API token is not set up yet.

creator_picks.text: add a small park with rides

decision_note: All three were built. The winner is a blocky parody leader who builds soldiers and a rocket. The two picks were joined into one loop: riding the park's rides earns charms, and a charm recruits any character into the Cult of the Cube.
